create_NYUv2Dataset_instance: create an NYUv2Dataset instance with data_path, filenames, height, width, frame_idxs, num_scales, and is_train args
use_get_color_method: use the get_color method to load and center-crop a color image with optional left-right flip
use_get_depth_method: use the get_depth method to load and center-crop a numpy depth ground truth array with optional flip
access_camera_intrinsics_K: access the camera intrinsics matrix K as a 4x4 float32 numpy array on the dataset instance
iterate_dataset_with_getitem: iterate the dataset using getitem to retrieve color images, augmented colors, K matrices, and depth ground truth
